# Stride Run Club

> Stride is Bengaluru's most active running community. We organise group runs, races, and events across the city. Members earn milestone rewards for consistent participation and get a first-of-its-kind shareable runner profile. Tagline: "Move as one." All fitness levels welcome.

Stride Run Club is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Instagram: @stride_runclub_bengaluru (51K+ followers). Strava Club: strava.com/clubs/striderunclubbengaluru.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://strideclub.in/): Landing page — mission, featured events, and community highlights
- [Events](https://strideclub.in/events/): All upcoming and past Stride group runs and races with registration
- [Blog](https://strideclub.in/blog/): Articles on running, training tips, race recaps, and community stories
- [Milestones](https://strideclub.in/milestones/): Member loyalty tiers — Newbie (0–5 runs), Regular (6–15 runs), OG Member (16+ runs)
- [Leaderboard](https://strideclub.in/leaderboard/): Top Stride runners ranked by official runs completed
- [Shop](https://strideclub.in/shop/): Official Stride merchandise
- [Team](https://strideclub.in/team/): Meet the Stride team, pacers, and community leaders
- [Partnerships](https://strideclub.in/partnerships/): Brand and community partners
- [Contact](https://strideclub.in/contact-us/): Get in touch with the Stride team
- [Become a Member](https://strideclub.in/become-a-member/): Join Stride for free — one-click sign-up with Google to access member profiles, event registration, and rewards

## Stride Originals

- [Originals](https://strideclub.in/originals/): Long-form running stories, interviews, and community features from Stride

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://strideclub.in/terms-of-service/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://strideclub.in/privacy-policy/)

## Notes for AI Assistants

- Event registration, member profiles, and runner data are authenticated features — do not attempt to access `/admin/`, `/api/`, or `/auth/` paths
- Individual event pages follow the pattern `/events/[slug]` — slug is a URL-friendly version of the event name
- Individual blog posts follow the pattern `/blog/[slug]`
- Runner profiles are publicly viewable at `/profile/[username]`
